mechanism: Integration of a thin, flexible, and compressible material (e.g., silicone or polyurethane) into the staple line to provide real-time compression feedback
how_it_addresses_failure: The compressible material will deform and change its shape in response to varying tissue compression, providing a non-invasive and real-time measurement of tissue compression
falsifier: If the compressible material does not deform in response to varying tissue compression, or if it compromises the stapler's firing mechanism

mechanism: Implementation of a miniature ultrasonic sensor to measure tissue compression in real-time and adjust the firing mechanism accordingly
how_it_addresses_failure: The ultrasonic sensor will emit high-frequency sound waves that will be reflected back by the tissue, allowing for accurate measurement of tissue compression and adjustment of the firing mechanism
falsifier: If the ultrasonic sensor does not accurately measure tissue compression or if it interferes with the stapler's firing mechanism

mechanism: Development of a shape-memory alloy (SMA) staple that will change its shape in response to varying tissue compression, providing real-time feedback
how_it_addresses_failure: The SMA staple will change its shape in response to varying tissue compression, indicating to the user whether the tissue compression is within the desired range
falsifier: If the SMA staple does not change its shape in response to varying tissue compression, or if it compromises the stapler's firing mechanism

mechanism: Integration of a micro-electromechanical systems (MEMS) pressure sensor into the staple line to measure tissue compression in real-time
how_it_addresses_failure: The MEMS pressure sensor will provide accurate and real-time measurement of tissue compression, allowing for adjustment of the firing mechanism
falsifier: If the MEMS pressure sensor does not accurately measure tissue compression or if it interferes with the stapler's firing mechanism

mechanism: Implementation of a piezoelectric actuator that will redistribute energy from the firing mechanism to a separate sensor, allowing for real-time measurement of tissue compression
how_it_addresses_failure: The piezoelectric actuator will redistribute energy from the firing mechanism to the sensor, allowing for accurate and real-time measurement of tissue compression
falsifier: If the piezoelectric actuator does not redistribute energy correctly or if it compromises the stapler's firing mechanism
